title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Crimes Involving Medical Services
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Publishes Typical Cases of Crimes Against Medical Professionals

Case 1

Wang Yingsheng — Intentional Homicide Case

-- Suspecting Improper Treatment Causing Doctor's Death, Crime Extremely Serious

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant: Wang Yingsheng, male, Han ethnicity, born on December 24, 1950, retired worker.

On October 14, 2012, the defendant Wang Yingsheng went to the First Teaching Hospital of Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine for medical treatment due to cerebral thrombosis. Kang Hongqian (victim, female, died at age 46), chief physician of the acupuncture department, performed acupuncture treatment on him. After receiving treatment, Wang Yingsheng felt that his pain had not been alleviated but had worsened. He believed this was caused by Kang Hongqian's acupuncture and developed the intent to retaliate. At approximately 1:00 p.m. on November 29 of the same year, Wang Yingsheng carried an axe to the fourteenth acupuncture consultation room on the second floor of the hospital where Kang Hongqian was stationed. He struck Kang Hongqian multiple times on the head and face with the axe, causing severe craniocerebral injury resulting in death. After committing the crime, Wang Yingsheng jumped from the window of the consultation room, fell to the ground injured, and was subsequently arrested at the scene by public security officers.

(2) Judgment

This case was tried at first instance by the Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court and at second instance by the Tianjin High People's Court. The Supreme People's Court conducted a review of the death penalty.

The court found upon trial that the defendant Wang Yingsheng intentionally and unlawfully deprived another person of life, and his conduct constituted the crime of intentional homicide. Wang Yingsheng, without justification, suspected that his failure to recover was due to improper treatment by the doctor, premeditated violent retaliation, entered the hospital with an axe and killed the treating physician. The method of the crime was cruel, the circumstances were vile, and the crime was extremely serious, warranting punishment according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Wang Yingsheng was sentenced to death and the sentence was approved.

The criminal Wang Yingsheng was executed according to law on April 22, 2014.

Case 2

Wang Yunsheng — Intentional Homicide Case

-- Killing Attending Physician Due to Dissatisfaction with Treatment Outcome, Crime Extremely Serious

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant: Wang Yunsheng, male, Han ethnicity, born on September 5, 1987, farmer.

The defendant Wang Yunsheng was hospitalized for pulmonary tuberculosis at the Third People's Hospital of Hengyang City, Hunan Province (South Campus) from July 27 to August 23, 2011. Upon admission, he was received by Chen Wenming, director of the Twelfth Ward, and later Chen Yuna (victim, female, died at age 33) served as his attending physician. During hospitalization, Wang Yunsheng was dissatisfied with the treatment outcome and had multiple disputes with Chen Yuna. After discharge, Wang Yunsheng found that his condition had deteriorated and believed this was due to Chen Yuna's actions of discontinuing, changing, or reducing medication during treatment. He thus developed resentment and decided to retaliate against Chen Yuna or Chen Wenming. To this end, Wang Yunsheng twice traveled from his workplace in Guangdong Province to Hengyang City to seek revenge, but on each occasion failed to carry out his plan due to various reasons. At approximately 2:00 p.m. on April 28, 2012, Wang Yunsheng brought a pre-prepared folding knife to the hospital, put on a mask, and entered the Twelfth Ward. Seeing Chen Yuna alone in the doctors' office, he stabbed her in the back. After being stabbed, Chen Yuna stood up and ran towards the office door, collapsing to the ground. Wang Yunsheng then approached her and stabbed her more than 20 times in the neck, chest, back, and other areas, causing her to die from hemorrhagic shock due to rupture of the carotid artery.

(2) Judgment

This case was tried at first instance by the Hengyang Intermediate People's Court, Hunan Province, and at second instance by the Hunan High People's Court. The Supreme People's Court conducted a review of the death penalty.

The court found upon trial that the defendant Wang Yunsheng intentionally and unlawfully deprived another person of life, and his conduct constituted the crime of intentional homicide. Wang Yunsheng, dissatisfied with the outcome of treatment during hospitalization, premeditated retaliation, stabbed the attending physician more than 20 times with a knife causing death. The method of the crime was cruel, the circumstances were vile, and the crime was extremely serious, warranting punishment according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Wang Yunsheng was sentenced to death and the sentence was approved.

The criminal Wang Yunsheng was executed according to law on April 21, 2014.

Case 3

Liu Xiaodong — Intentional Injury Case

-- Assaulting Doctor Causing Minor Injury Due to Dissatisfaction with Referral Recommendation

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant: Liu Xiaodong, male, Han ethnicity, born on July 3, 1968, unemployed.

At approximately 0:30 a.m. on December 3, 2012, the defendant Liu Xiaodong went to the Dandong Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital, Liaoning Province for treatment due to a head injury. Liu Xiaodong told the attending doctor Song Feng (victim, male, then aged 46) that he might have a skull fracture. Song Feng suggested that Liu Xiaodong go to another hospital for treatment. Liu Xiaodong was dissatisfied with Song Feng's recommendation for transfer. After leaving for about ten minutes, he returned, pulled off Song Feng's glasses, struck Song Feng's mouth and nose with his head, and beat Song Feng, causing two teeth to be broken and a linear fracture of the nasal bone, constituting minor injury.

(2) Judgment

The Zhenxing District People's Court of Dandong City, Liaoning Province found upon trial that the defendant Liu Xiaodong intentionally injured another person's body, causing minor injury, and his conduct constituted the crime of intentional injury. Liu Xiaodong, dissatisfied with the doctor's recommendation for transfer to another hospital during treatment, beat the doctor causing minor injury, and should be punished according to law. Given that Liu Xiaodong voluntarily confessed his guilt in court, a lighter punishment may be applied at the court's discretion. Accordingly, the defendant Liu Xiaodong was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year and four months according to law.

After the first-instance judgment in this case was pronounced, the defendant did not appeal and the procuratorial authority did not protest. The criminal part of the above judgment became legally effective on December 9, 2013.

Case 4

Bian Jingkui et al. — Affray Case

-- Randomly Assaulting Doctor and Vandalizing Property During Medical Visit, Vile Circumstances

(1) Basic Facts

Defendants:

Bian Jingkui, male, Han ethnicity, born on September 7, 1992, farmer.

Bian Long, male, Han ethnicity, born on September 7, 1986, farmer.

Liu Hao, male, Han ethnicity, born on October 15, 1982, farmer.

Wang Funan, male, Han ethnicity, born on January 6, 1984, farmer.

Song Xiaomeng, male, Han ethnicity, born on April 18, 1985, farmer.

Jiang Yu, male, Han ethnicity, born on April 3, 1985, farmer.

On the evening of November 9, 2013, the defendants Bian Jingkui, Bian Long, Liu Hao, Wang Funan, Song Xiaomeng, and Jiang Yu drank alcohol together. At approximately 11:00 p.m. that day, Bian Jingkui, accompanied by the other five, went to the Ningbo Seventh Hospital, Zhejiang Province for treatment of a hand injury. Because they violated the medical procedure by requesting an X-ray without following the proper process, the on-duty radiologists Wang Chengwei and Qin Pengcheng refused their request. The six defendants then cursed and kicked open the door to the radiology office, entered, and beat Wang Chengwei and Qin Pengcheng, causing head and right upper limb injuries to Wang Chengwei, and skin lacerations to Qin Pengcheng's right ear, face, and lips. Both victims' injuries constituted minor injuries. The six defendants also damaged a medical monitor, a beech wood door, and two wooden stools in the radiology office, causing losses totaling RMB 4,167.

(2) Judgment

This case was tried at first instance by the Zhenhai District People's Court of Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, and at second instance by the Ningbo Intermediate People's Court.

The court found upon trial that the defendants Bian Jingkui, Bian Long, Liu Hao, Wang Funan, Song Xiaomeng, and Jiang Yu, after consuming alcohol, cursed at and randomly assaulted the on-duty doctors in the hospital, causing minor injuries to two persons, with vile circumstances; they arbitrarily damaged public or private property causing losses of RMB 4,167, which was serious in circumstances. Their conduct constituted the crime of affray and should be punished according to law. Bian Jingkui, Bian Long, Liu Hao, Song Xiaomeng, and Jiang Yu truthfully confessed their criminal facts after being brought to justice and voluntarily confessed their guilt, so they should be given a lighter punishment according to law; the above five persons actively compensated the victims and the victim unit for economic losses, so a lighter punishment may be applied at the court's discretion. Accordingly, the defendants Bian Jingkui and Wang Funan were each sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of eleven months; the defendants Song Xiaomeng and Jiang Yu were each sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of ten months; and the defendants Bian Long and Liu Hao were each sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of nine months.

The above judgments became legally effective on April 16, 2014.
